patterns.reason: Anonymous classes with a single method can be converted to lambda expressions (SAM conversion) as introduced by JEP 126.

rule_description: Java SE 8 adds lambda expressions, method references, and enhanced type inference. Anonymous inner classes implementing a single abstract method (SAM) interface can be replaced with lambda expressions, reducing boilerplate and enabling internal iteration idioms. Per JEP 126, lambda expressions are expressions with concise syntax to represent the desired operation, in lieu of one or more explicit loops.
rule_name: Convert anonymous SAM classes to lambda expressions
verification_hint: Compile with Java 8 javac; verify convertible anonymous SAM classes were replaced with lambdas, non-convertible ones (field state, multiple methods, `this`-qualified self-reference, multi-abstract-method interfaces) are left SKIPPED, and behavior is unchanged.
